title: Log-likelihood without underflow
statement_md:
`likelihood(probs, labels)` already multiplies probabilities — and underflows to zero.

Add `log_likelihood(probs, labels)` returning the **sum of logs**: `log p` where the label is 1, `log(1 - p)` where it is 0. Do not change `likelihood`.
mutations: return sum(math.log(p) for p in probs)
